newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary's forint ends down vs dlr, steady vs basket.
newsitem.headline: Hungary's forint ends down vs dlr, steady vs basket.

text.p: Hungary's forint closed slightly lower against the dollar on Wednesday, tracking the movements of the dollar/mark cross on international markets, dealers said.
The forint closed at 181.25/30 to the dollar, compared with 181.22/27 at midday and the opening of 181.15/20.
The forint followed the dollar/mark in brisk trade and remained pinned to the National Bank of Hungary's (NBH) floating resistance level (bid), dealers said.
Speculation, boosted by the fall of the dollar following the publication of U.S. April PPI data, could not move the forint away from the NBH bid, they added.
"Many people tried to play on the dipping of the dollar," said Laszlo Egyed of WestLB Hungaria. "But this did not push the forint down from the (NBH) bid."
(NBH floating intervention range: 4.5 percent wide. NBH currency basket: 30 percent dollar + 70 percent mark.)
